name: Betrayal from Within
summary: At Camp Taurajo, Betrayal from Within begins with Mangletooth's offer of bloody vengeance. Imprisoned in a cage, the quilboar says his kin left him for dead. He offers Horde travelers knowledge of the three Razormane warlords who emerged from Razorfen Kraul to organize assaults across the Barrens.

sections.title: A Grudge in a Cage
sections.body: At Camp Taurajo, Mangletooth has lost all loyalty to his Razormane kin. They left him behind in defeat, and he faces execution in his cage. Now he wants vengeance against the leaders who abandoned him. He offers Horde travelers knowledge of the true architects behind the ruthless raids across the plains.

sections.title: The Warlords of the Kraul
sections.body: Razormane attacks keep troubling the Horde, and Thork at the Crossroads struggles to curb them. Mangletooth names three commanders from deep within Razorfen Kraul: Lok Orcbane, a formidable warrior, and his companions Nak, a tracker, and Kuz, a spellcaster. They direct Razormane raiders from encampments far to the south. Mangletooth demands their severed skulls as proof that his betrayers have fallen before his own end arrives.

faq.q: Why is a quilboar helping the Horde?
faq.answer: Mangletooth helps the Horde for revenge, not friendship. His brethren turned their backs on him and left him to die in a cage at Camp Taurajo. Since he believes his own death is inevitable, he wants his betrayers dead first.

faq.q: Who are Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane?
faq.answer: Nak, Kuz, and Lok Orcbane are three Razormane leaders who emerged from Razorfen Kraul to organize raids across the Barrens. Lok Orcbane is a vicious warrior, joined by Nak the tracker and Kuz the spellcaster.

faq.q: Where are the three targets found?
faq.answer: They make their camps far to the south of the Barrens, within Razormane territories near the southern brushlands.

faq.q: What does Mangletooth mean about Thork being wrong?
faq.answer: Thork manages defenses from the Crossroads and believes he knows who directs the quilboar attacks on Horde supply lines. Mangletooth says Thork is wrong: Lok Orcbane, Nak, and Kuz are behind the attacks.

faq.q: Will killing these leaders truly bring peace with the Razormane?
faq.answer: Mangletooth claims that killing the three will ease Razormane raids on the Crossroads and much of the Barrens. Their fall would break the immediate southern leadership, but quilboar hostility across the Barrens would remain.

faq.q: What happens to Mangletooth after this?
faq.answer: Mangletooth believes his death is inescapable while he is locked in a Horde encampment. He seeks neither escape nor mercy, only the satisfaction of bringing down his treacherous tribe mates before his end.

angles.text: Stopping Lok Orcbane and his cohorts strikes at the leaders responsible for brutalizing Horde caravans and outposts across the southern Barrens.
Lok Orcbane bears that name for his prowess and hatred in slaughtering orcish travelers across the territory.
Camp Taurajo lies along the southern corridor where Razormane aggression runs hottest, making these warlords' deaths critical to local security.
